text: Conservationist Adam Hitchens [moves his wife Claire and baby Finn to a remote Irish village|trigger|making a new home] beside a great forest, where he finds an animal carcass burst open by a strange fungus. The villagers tell them to put back the iron bars on the house, and a hostile neighbour hands Claire an old book about the Hallow, [fairies who steal babies and leave changelings|wants|taking someone's place]. When the creatures come out of the dark, [only light holds them back|rules|it has a fatal weakness], and a single sting [sets the fungus growing through Adam's body|rules|the body changes].
